values.en: For an arc-length parametrized curve $\gamma$ with $\gamma''\neq 0$, the Frenet frame is right-handed: the binormal is the cross product of the tangent vector and the principal normal, $$\boldsymbol{b}_\gamma(t)=\boldsymbol{t}_\gamma(t)\wedge\boldsymbol{n}_\gamma(t).$$ Together with orthonormality this says that $(\boldsymbol{t}_\gamma(t),\boldsymbol{n}_\gamma(t),\boldsymbol{b}_\gamma(t))$ is a positively oriented orthonormal basis of $\mathbb{R}^{3}$.
values.zh-CN: 对满足 $\gamma''\neq 0$ 的以弧长为参数的曲线 $\gamma$，Frenet 标架是右手系：副法向量是切向量与主法向量的叉积，即 $$\boldsymbol{b}_\gamma(t)=\boldsymbol{t}_\gamma(t)\wedge\boldsymbol{n}_\gamma(t).$$ 与规范正交性合起来，这表明 $(\boldsymbol{t}_\gamma(t),\boldsymbol{n}_\gamma(t),\boldsymbol{b}_\gamma(t))$ 是 $\mathbb{R}^{3}$ 的一组正向规范正交基。
